title: Sudoku
description: Challenge your brain with this classic number placement puzzle.
about:
Sudoku is a browser game where you fill the grid so each row, column and 3 × 3 box contains each digit from 1 to 9 once.

Start a round in your browser and use the controls below to play.
howToPlay: Fill the grid so each row, column and 3 × 3 box contains each digit from 1 to 9 once.
tips: Use click / tap to select a cell.
Try another round to practice the timing and strategy.

faq.question: How do I play Sudoku?
faq.answer: Fill the grid so each row, column and 3 × 3 box contains each digit from 1 to 9 once.

faq.question: Can I play Sudoku in a browser?
faq.answer: Yes. Open the game page and play without installing an app.
